manifest.name: dsh-superagent
manifest.author: DeepSeek Harness Team <team@dsh.dev>
manifest.description: A proactive agent for one GitHub repository, as a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) bundle: it listens to GitHub and optionally Feishu, evaluates requests under a Policy, turns authorized ones into Tickets, and executes each in its own DSH Session. Fork: one GitHub account can request and act, and the worker environment stays out of the host process.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

bundle.text:
# dsh-superagent bundle layer: inserts the plugins with a default state directory, and the agent presets its
# Sessions run under. A profile may override `stateDir` (see docs/006-deployment.md and
# examples/profile.cordis.patch.yml); the default below makes the bundle installable without editing any file.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-superagent
      name: dsh-superagent
      config:
        stateDir: !!js dshHomePath('state/dsh-superagent')
    - id: dsh-superagent-github
      name: dsh-superagent/github-watch
    # Optional Feishu Source; requires configuring a bot CLI after enabling.
    - id: dsh-superagent-feishu
      name: dsh-superagent/feishu-watch
      disabled: true
    # The agent preset of every Executor Session (WORKER_PRESET in src/app/sessions.ts); the main Session has its own, below.
    # It is DSH's `standard` preset with only what a worker needs, and a shell whose foreground command moves to a background job
    # after 5 seconds, so a long command does not hold back a person's message, which the Session takes at its next step. Left
    # out: questions to a person, presenting, plan mode, the plugin manager and market, scheduling, goals, workflows, web fetch,
    # and forked subagents, which would run under this preset; spawned subagents run under `standard`, whose shell moves a
    # command to a background job only after 60 seconds, as a subagent's jobs are killed when it ends. A preset row has no
    # setting that hides it from the preset picker, so its name and description say whom it is for.
    - id: dsh-superagent-worker-preset
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-superagent-worker
        name: dsh-superagent 执行器
        description: dsh-superagent 的执行器 Session 专用，不供手动选择。前台命令超 5 秒转入后台，只含执行工作所需的工具。
        order: 90
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          # A foreground command waits at most 5 s, then the shell tool moves it to a background job.
          - id: shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              shell: true
            config:
              - id: bash-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: pwsh-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: tool-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
              - id: tool-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          # A wait for a job ends after 5 s too; the job's end wakes the worker with its result.
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
            config:
              waitTimeoutMs: 5000
              maxWaitTimeoutMs: 5000
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelection: true
                  modelDiscovery: true
                  agentPreset: standard
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: false
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
    # The agent preset of the main Session (ROUTER_PRESET in src/app/sessions.ts). The worker's 5-second shell and job waits, so a command or a wait does not hold back the next candidates, and
    # only what the main Session uses: no subagents, web, file search or writes, todo list, questions to a person, presenting,
    # plan mode, plugin manager, scheduling, goals or workflows. No persona: the main Session's prompt is complete, so it has
    # no other section.
    - id: dsh-superagent-router-preset
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-superagent-router
        name: dsh-superagent 主 Session
        description: dsh-superagent 的主 Session 专用，不供手动选择。前台命令和任务等待超 5 秒转入后台，只含路由所需的工具。
        order: 91
        plugins:
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              shell: true
            config:
              - id: bash-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: pwsh-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: tool-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
              - id: tool-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
            config:
              write: false
              edit: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
            config:
              waitTimeoutMs: 5000
              maxWaitTimeoutMs: 5000
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024

readme.text:
> **Research prototype for reference only, not an official DeepSeek product.** This code grew out of our team's day-to-day development work, with much of the engineering done by coding agents. Treat it as research code, not production-ready software. It may still contain bugs, and its coding style and engineering practices may be inconsistent. Review and adapt it before using it in your own environment.
>
> We have adapted it for publication, so it is not identical to our internal version or the implementation described in *Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System*. Some designs discussed in the article are directions for future development and are not implemented in this prototype.

This repository is a fork of [deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype). It keeps the upstream design and adds the changes under [Fork notes](#fork-notes--本分支说明).

dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/). It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory, and answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person.

It is also a way of working with an agent: **take as little human attention as possible, and give as much value as possible.** An agent that can act for a whole team can also waste a whole team's attention, so it acts only when asked or when a rule the team wrote allows it, and speaks only when someone must act or can use a result. [docs/000-philosophy.md](docs/000-philosophy.md) explains the principle and what it asks of the operator.
dsh-superagent is a DSH bundle: `dsh plugin` installs it into one profile, next to the plugins that profile already loads.

- [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) 0.2.1-alpha.2 or later. The desktop app 0.2.1-rc.5 is known to work.
- `gh` 2.48 or later and `git` 2.32 or later on `PATH`: the GitHub Source calls `gh`, and ticket checkouts use `git`.
- Optional, only for the Feishu Source: `lark-cli` and a Feishu or Lark app with a bot.

Node.js 22.19+ or 24+ is needed only when you build from source; the release tarball ships the built `lib/`.

Restart that profile — quit and reopen the desktop app, or restart `dsh web` — then choose **Superagent** in the sidebar.

The bundle ships a default state directory, `<DSH_HOME>/state/dsh-superagent`, for its database, locks, worker shims and ticket directories. To keep it elsewhere, add this to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` before the first start:

```yaml
- id: dsh-superagent
  config:
    stateDir: /absolute/path
```

`stateDir` cannot change after the first start.

1. **Sources → GitHub**: the repository as `owner/name`, and the `gh` CLI the agent acts as. The agent comments, pushes and opens pull requests as that account, so it needs write access; a dedicated account keeps its work distinguishable from yours.
2. **Policy**: the GitHub logins allowed to ask for work. Until the list has someone, no request can become a ticket.
3. **Execution**: the ticket directory root and a `prepare` command that gives each ticket its own checkout, for example a `git worktree` of a local clone.

Then ask for work from an allowed account: open an Issue or comment on one, mentioning the agent, for example `@<agent-login> fix the typo in the README`. With [shared-account mode](#shared-account-mode), the comment must *start* with the mention.

[docs/006-deployment.md](docs/006-deployment.md) covers the accounts, the `prepare` command template, upgrades and troubleshooting; [SETUP.md](SETUP.md) is the guided setup an agent can follow with you.

Setup has many steps, so an agent does it with you. Ask your coding agent:

> Read SETUP.md in this repository and set up dsh-superagent with me.

It asks one short question at a time, shows the full plan once, and then installs and configures everything. [SETUP.md](SETUP.md) is what it follows.

- [000 Philosophy](docs/000-philosophy.md)
- [001 Domain model](docs/001-domain.md)
- [002 Authorization](docs/002-authorization.md)
- [003 Execution](docs/003-execution.md)
- [004 Prompts](docs/004-prompts.md)
- [005 Panel](docs/005-panel.md)
- [006 Deployment](docs/006-deployment.md): manual setup, configuration, upgrades and troubleshooting
- [007 Architecture](docs/007-architecture.md)
- [008 Cookbook](docs/008-cookbook.md): adding a Source
This copy adds two changes on top of the upstream research prototype, for using it inside a shared DSH profile with one GitHub account:

- **One account can request and act.** A message the agent's own account writes counts as that account's explicit request when it *starts* with `@<login>`; its other messages (acknowledgements, progress, results) are still ignored, so the agent cannot trigger itself in a loop.
- **The worker environment stays out of the host process.** `PATH`, `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` and `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM` are applied only for the setup check and restored at once. Installing the bundle into a profile you also use for other Sessions no longer changes their git or `PATH`; worker sessions use the operator's own CLI and git configuration, which one shared account makes equivalent.

When the agent and the people asking share one GitHub account, mentioning yourself sends no notification, so the Source cannot rely on the account's notifications. Turn on **Receive new Issues** and **Receive comments in the repository** on the GitHub Source; it then reads the repository directly, and a comment that starts with the agent's mention becomes an explicit request. Messages of that account that do not start with the mention are treated as the agent's own output and ignored, which keeps acknowledgements and results from triggering new tickets.
`pnpm check` runs the typecheck, the tests and the build.
